title: Translated related-list titles, follow-ups of #36528: a placed title the source row does not carry can be stored translated on save, and three narrower edges
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed by the seat from the contract review of PR #36574 (#36528), record 7089245527 at `6fd5bb8573ec4fbcdb37772a5e6aabbf48871b17`, section ③ (escalated to the seat) and ④ (N4, N5). One card for the family. Related: #36528, #36575.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:server` (item 1 and 2 land in `packages/metadata-protocol` / `packages/objectql`; item 3 is a spec docblock, item 4 lint)

## Items

1. **Save door (main item).** After #36528 a title that a code extender's `place` splices into an owner's `relatedLists` is translated on the real `/meta` read. If a stored overlay row declares `relatedLists` without that placed entry (saved before the placing package was installed), `restoreTranslatedEchoes` has no source to compare with, so a non-source-locale save of the folded read would store the translation as the title. A field a code extender adds has the same edge. Whether a Studio save reaches it depends on the draft read (not folded today); establish that first. The review suggests one fix for both slots: the packaged base as the last source for what a code extender brings.
2. **N4.** The packaged base judges "declares `relatedLists`" on the owner; the fold judges it on its base layer (`overlay ?? own`). Where a tenant overlay row declares a tab list the owner does not, the placed title reads as diverged and is not translated from the catalog. No wrong text; decide fix or documented deviation.
3. **N5.** `TranslateDocumentOptions.packagedBase` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` lists what an object's base carries beyond the owner as `validations` and added `fields`, but not placed `relatedLists` entries. Docblock only.
4. **Lint union (dev's out-of-scope finding).** `translation-target-unknown` can accept an owner's labelled key whose entry a `.custom` arrangement hides or replaces, because the labelled check runs before the hidden check. Permissive, lint-only, no false red.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "relatedListLabel\|restoreTranslatedEchoes" packages/metadata-protocol/src` still shows the per-source comparison; item 1 is fixed when a test pins that a non-source-locale save of a placed title, with a stored row lacking the entry, keeps the source title.
